The '''Blockade of the Cularin system''' was a blockade by the [[Thaereian military]] which prevented medical supplies and foodstuffs from reaching the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. [[Veneziano Haas]] was recruited by [[Nirama]] to have [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] outrun the blockade and deliver supplies.
